findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_book, get_free_key · Public sink: check_book, check_invoice, check_quote_math, get_free_key · Destructive: check_invoice, check_quote_math.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_book, get_free_key · Public sink: check_book, check_invoice, check_quote_math, get_free_key · Destructive: check_invoice, check_quote_math

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
